discovery: Symbol-based: TypeScript program + checker over every src/**/*.ts. Locators are "file::Container.member" with no line numbers. Missing or ambiguous anchors fail generation.
status_note: Generated against pre-D1.7 source. Regenerate after D1.7 lands; locators for host/session code are expected to move.

read_worker.transport: Node child_process.fork IPC, serialization "advanced" (structured clone). D1.9 defines the portable JSON envelope.

read_worker.reply_error_shape: Operation failure with an open document: {value: undefined, metadata, error: <diagnostic message>} -> QueryWorkerOperationError(message, metadata). Without a document: {id, error}.

host.transport: In-process calls on the host document object (ViewerFile).

trusted_writer.transport: In-process; the reader is closed first (ViewerFile.withReaderClosed), a fresh DuckDbFile writer or xlsxWrite.patchCell performs the write, then the reader reopens.
